title: Smart Plant Watering System
description: An automated plant watering system that monitors soil moisture and waters plants when needed. Great for learning about sensors and automation.

steps.title: Set up Arduino
steps.desc: Connect the Arduino Uno to your computer via USB.

steps.title: Wire moisture sensor
steps.desc: Connect the soil moisture sensor to analog pin A0.

steps.title: Add relay and pump
steps.desc: Wire relay module to pin D7, connect small pump.

steps.title: Upload code
steps.desc: Upload the watering sketch and test the threshold.

steps.title: Install in pot
steps.desc: Place sensor in soil and secure the setup.

safety_notes: Relay switches mains if using a mains pump – use a 5V USB pump instead.

title: Obstacle Avoiding Robot
description: Build a robot that navigates around obstacles using ultrasonic sensing and DC motors. A classic intro to robotics.

steps.title: Chassis assembly
steps.desc: Mount two DC motors on the chassis.

steps.title: Wire motor driver
steps.desc: Connect L298N driver to motors and Arduino.

steps.title: Attach sensor
steps.desc: Mount ultrasonic sensor on front, wire to Arduino.

steps.title: Program logic
steps.desc: Upload obstacle avoidance sketch.

steps.title: Test and tune
steps.desc: Adjust thresholds and test on a flat surface.

safety_notes: Keep fingers clear of moving wheels during testing.

title: LED Mood Lamp
description: Create a customizable ambient lamp with colour-changing LEDs. Perfect for creative spaces.

steps.title: Connect LED strip
steps.desc: Wire WS2812 data line to Arduino pin D6.

steps.title: Power the strip
steps.desc: Use external 5V 2A supply for the LEDs.

steps.title: Upload code
steps.desc: Install FastLED library and upload colour-cycle sketch.

steps.title: Diffuser
steps.desc: Place inside a frosted jar or PVC tube.

safety_notes: Do not run the full LED strip from the Arduino 5V pin.

title: Digital Weather Station
description: Display real-time temperature and humidity on an LCD screen. Great for learning about environmental sensing.

steps.title: Wire DHT sensor
steps.desc: Connect DHT11 data pin to Arduino D2.

steps.title: Connect LCD
steps.desc: Wire 16x2 LCD via I2C backpack.

steps.title: Upload code
steps.desc: Use DHT and LiquidCrystal_I2C libraries.

steps.title: Box it up
steps.desc: Mount in a vented enclosure.

title: Smart Night Light
description: An automatic night light that turns on when it gets dark using a light sensor and LED.

steps.title: Wire LDR
steps.desc: Connect LDR in voltage divider to analog pin A0.

steps.title: Connect LED
steps.desc: Wire LED with resistor to pin D9.

steps.title: Upload code
steps.desc: Upload a threshold-based on/off sketch.

steps.title: Test
steps.desc: Cover the LDR and confirm LED switches on.

title: Motion-Activated Alarm
description: A security alarm that triggers a buzzer when motion is detected. Learn about PIR sensors.

steps.title: Connect PIR
steps.desc: Wire PIR output to Arduino digital pin D3.

steps.title: Add buzzer
steps.desc: Connect buzzer to pin D8 via transistor.

steps.title: Program
steps.desc: Upload motion-detection and alarm sketch.

steps.title: Mount
steps.desc: Fix PIR at door height and test with movement.

title: Bluetooth Speaker
description: Salvage the speaker from an old device and build a portable Bluetooth audio receiver.

steps.title: Extract speaker
steps.desc: Carefully desolder the speaker from old device.

steps.title: Wire amplifier
steps.desc: Connect a PAM8403 amplifier to the speaker.

steps.title: Add Bluetooth module
steps.desc: Wire HC-05 to the amplifier input.

steps.title: Power and test
steps.desc: Power with 5V supply and pair your phone.

steps.title: Enclose
steps.desc: Mount in a wooden box or repurposed tin.

safety_notes: Check battery condition before use – do not use swollen or leaking batteries.

title: IR Remote Control Car
description: Build a simple remote-controlled car using salvaged motors and an IR remote.

steps.title: Build chassis
steps.desc: Attach motors to a cardboard or printed chassis.

steps.title: Wire driver
steps.desc: Connect L293D driver between Arduino and motors.

steps.title: Add IR receiver
steps.desc: Wire IR sensor to Arduino D11.

steps.title: Map remote
steps.desc: Upload IR decoding sketch and map buttons.

steps.title: Test drive
steps.desc: Test in an open area and tune speed.

title: Digital Dice
description: An electronic dice using LEDs and a button. Great beginner project for random numbers and I/O.

steps.title: Wire LEDs
steps.desc: Wire LEDs in dice pattern to Arduino pins.

steps.title: Add button
steps.desc: Connect push button to pin D2 with pull-up.

steps.title: Program
steps.desc: Upload random number generator with LED logic.

steps.title: Box it
steps.desc: Mount in a small enclosure.

title: Servo-Controlled Pan/Tilt Mount
description: Build a motorized camera or sensor mount that pans and tilts. Useful for security or photography.

steps.title: Print or cut bracket
steps.desc: Create bracket for two servos to hold camera.

steps.title: Mount servos
steps.desc: Attach pan servo to base, tilt servo on arm.

steps.title: Wire to Arduino
steps.desc: Connect servo signal wires to D9 and D10.

steps.title: Control
steps.desc: Upload control sketch and test movement.

title: OLED Clock
description: A compact digital clock displayed on a salvaged OLED screen, powered by Arduino.

steps.title: Wire OLED
steps.desc: Connect OLED via I2C (SDA to A4, SCL to A5).

steps.title: Add RTC
steps.desc: Wire DS3231 RTC on same I2C bus.

steps.title: Upload code
steps.desc: Use U8g2 and RTClib libraries.

steps.title: Set time
steps.desc: Set current time in setup() and upload.

steps.title: Enclose
steps.desc: Fit in a small 3D-printed stand.

title: Wireless Sensor Network Node
description: Create a battery-powered sensor node that transmits temperature and humidity wirelessly.

steps.title: Transmitter node
steps.desc: Wire Arduino + DHT22 + NRF24L01 as sender.

steps.title: Receiver node
steps.desc: Wire second Arduino + NRF24L01 + LCD as receiver.

steps.title: Program both
steps.desc: Upload sender and receiver sketches.

steps.title: Test range
steps.desc: Move nodes apart and verify data reception.

steps.title: Power optimise
steps.desc: Add sleep mode for battery saving.

safety_notes: NRF24L01 requires 3.3V – do not connect to 5V.

title: Fan Speed Controller
description: Add variable speed control to a salvaged DC fan using PWM from an Arduino.

steps.title: Check fan voltage
steps.desc: Identify fan voltage (usually 5V or 12V).

steps.title: Wire transistor
steps.desc: Connect TIP120 transistor between Arduino and fan.

steps.title: Add potentiometer
steps.desc: Wire pot to analog pin A0 for speed control.

steps.title: Upload PWM code
steps.desc: Upload analogWrite fan speed sketch.

steps.title: Test safety
steps.desc: Confirm fan does not overheat at low speeds.

safety_notes: If the fan runs on mains voltage, do NOT connect to Arduino.

title: Stepper Motor Pen Plotter
description: Build a simple 2-axis drawing machine using salvaged stepper motors from an old printer.

steps.title: Extract steppers
steps.desc: Remove stepper motors from old printer.

steps.title: Build frame
steps.desc: Construct XY gantry from cardboard or MDF.

steps.title: Wire drivers
steps.desc: Connect stepper drivers to Arduino.

steps.title: Add pen mount
steps.desc: Attach servo to lift pen.

steps.title: Upload firmware
steps.desc: Use GRBL or custom plotter firmware.

steps.title: Calibrate
steps.desc: Draw test patterns and calibrate steps/mm.

safety_notes: Ensure moving parts cannot trap fingers during testing.

title: Bike Safety Light
description: Build a bright rechargeable LED tail-light for cycling, powered by a salvaged phone battery.

steps.title: Select LEDs
steps.desc: Choose high-brightness red LEDs or LED strip section.

steps.title: Add charger
steps.desc: Wire a TP4056 charger to the phone battery.

steps.title: Add switch
steps.desc: Include on/off and blink mode switch.

steps.title: Enclose
steps.desc: Mount in a weatherproof case.

safety_notes: Use only undamaged, non-swollen batteries. Include a fuse.

title: Clap-Activated Switch
description: Control a light or fan with a clap using a sound sensor and relay.

steps.title: Wire sound sensor
steps.desc: Connect KY-038 mic to Arduino A0.

steps.title: Add relay
steps.desc: Connect relay module to pin D7.

steps.title: Program
steps.desc: Upload double-clap detection sketch.

steps.title: Wire appliance
steps.desc: Connect a low-voltage LED lamp through relay.

safety_notes: Never connect mains voltage through the relay yourself.

title: Retro Game Console
description: Transform a Raspberry Pi into a retro gaming console with a salvaged phone battery.

steps.title: Install RetroPie
steps.desc: Flash RetroPie image to microSD card.

steps.title: Power bank circuit
steps.desc: Wire phone battery + TP4056 + boost converter.

steps.title: Connect display
steps.desc: Wire small TFT or OLED display to Pi.

steps.title: Add controls
steps.desc: Connect GPIO buttons or small gamepad.

steps.title: Enclose
steps.desc: 3D-print or carve a handheld case.

safety_notes: Battery + boost converter combination requires protection circuitry.

title: Soil Erosion Monitor
description: A sensor array that monitors soil moisture at multiple depths to study erosion or guide irrigation.

steps.title: Array wiring
steps.desc: Connect three moisture sensors to A0, A1, A2.

steps.title: Add display
steps.desc: Show readings on LCD or serial plotter.

steps.title: Data logging
steps.desc: Log to SD card with timestamps.

steps.title: Waterproof
steps.desc: Apply conformal coating to sensor traces.

steps.title: Field install
steps.desc: Insert sensors at different soil depths.

safety_notes: Waterproof all exposed electronics in outdoor installations.

title: Talking Distance Meter
description: An ultrasonic distance meter that announces measurements through a speaker. Good for accessibility.

steps.title: Wire ultrasonic
steps.desc: Connect HC-SR04 to D9 (trig) and D10 (echo).

steps.title: Add speaker
steps.desc: Wire speaker via small amplifier to Arduino.

steps.title: Program TTS
steps.desc: Use a TTS chip or pre-recorded audio clips.

steps.title: Enclose
steps.desc: Fit in a handheld enclosure.

title: Electronic Compost Monitor
description: Monitor temperature and moisture inside a compost bin to optimise decomposition rates.

steps.title: Waterproof sensor
steps.desc: Coat DHT22 and probe in epoxy for moisture.

steps.title: Wire Arduino
steps.desc: Connect sensors to Arduino analog and digital pins.

steps.title: Add display
steps.desc: Show temp and moisture on OLED.

steps.title: Power
steps.desc: Use solar panel + battery for outdoor power.

steps.title: Mount
steps.desc: Insert probe in compost heap and fix display on lid.

safety_notes: Seal all electronics from moisture. Do not submerge the Arduino.
